description: This Java class provides a fluent API for building and configuring HTTP request headers specifically for use within the RootRoute in an Eclipse Ditto gateway service. It supports constructing DittoHeaders objects step-by-step, including applying headers from request context, query parameters, and custom configurations, while ensuring size constraints and handling duplicates.

classes.name: RootRouteHeadersStepBuilder
classes.description: A final class providing a fluent API for building DittoHeaders with a stepwise process that includes setting initial headers, request context, query parameters, and finalizing into a CompletionStage.

classes.name: RootRouteHeadersStepBuilder.RequestContextStep
classes.description: Builder step for setting the RequestContext and extracting headers from an HTTP request.

classes.name: RootRouteHeadersStepBuilder.QueryParametersStep
classes.description: Builder step for incorporating query parameters into headers, avoiding conflicts with existing external headers.

classes.name: RootRouteHeadersStepBuilder.BuildStep
classes.description: Final builder step that generates a CompletionStage of DittoHeaders, including handling custom headers and size checks.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of RootRouteHeadersStepBuilder with provided dependencies.

methods.name: withInitialDittoHeadersBuilder
methods.description: Sets the initial DittoHeadersBuilder for constructing headers.
